cmsFields.title: Apache Airflow 3.4 review: orchestration trade-offs
cmsFields.subtitle: What the scheduler enforces, what task authors must guarantee, and which deployment trade-offs remain yours.
cmsFields.summary: Apache Airflow 3.4 review: inspect DAG scheduling, executor trade-offs, retry-safe tasks, deployment needs, and trust boundaries. No benchmarks claimed.
keyTakeaways: Airflow coordinates workflow tasks; it is not a continuous stream-processing engine.
The inspected scheduler accounts for executor parallelism and pool capacity before enqueueing tasks.
Retries do not make external writes exactly-once; tasks need repeatable inputs and retry-safe effects.
Production database, executor, logs, DAG distribution, and trust boundaries require deliberate choices.
